g.desc: Experiment 1 inventory: title at upper left; study phase has participant counterbalancing text, two passage documents stacked vertically, branching arrows into a dashed post-study manipulation frame; manipulation frame has a yellow restudy condition panel above a teal test condition panel; both converge to a retention interval box with clock/calendar icons and labels, then arrow to final free recall test document-with-pencil icon and recall instruction text. Symmetry basis: upper passage and lower passage are vertically paired about the study-phase midline; post-study conditions are stacked in parallel; retention choices are horizontally equipartitioned.

Experiment 2 inventory: title below dashed divider; study phase at left with a single prose-passage document, arrow to a three-way branch labeled SSSS/SSST/STTT; dashed four-learning-periods frame contains three rows of four S/T tiles connected by thin horizontal lines; rows converge and lead to a retention interval box with two choices, then to final free recall icon and instruction text. A separate dashed legend at lower right explains S and T tiles. Symmetry basis: schedules form a 3-by-4 grid with equal column spacing; retention choices are horizontally paired; legend entries are vertically paired.

Post-replacement mappings established from full-figure objects and annotated SAM overview: exp1 clock 5 min - draft_exp1_clock_5min - asset_sam_region_000019; exp2 clock 5 min - draft_exp2_clock_5min - asset_sam_region_000020; exp2 1 week calendar - draft_exp2_cal_1week - asset_sam_region_000021; exp1 1 week calendar - draft_exp1_cal_1week - asset_sam_region_000022; exp1 2 days calendar - draft_exp1_cal_2days - asset_sam_region_000023; exp1 final recall icon - draft_exp1_final_recall_icon - asset_sam_region_000024; exp2 final recall icon - draft_exp2_final_recall_icon - asset_sam_region_000025; exp1 test condition icon - draft_exp1_test_doc_pen - asset_sam_region_000026; exp1 Sea Otters document - draft_exp1_doc_otters - asset_sam_region_000027; exp1 The Sun document - draft_exp1_doc_sun - asset_sam_region_000028; exp1 restudy small document - draft_exp1_restudy_small_doc - asset_sam_region_000029; exp2 one prose passage document - draft_exp2_study_doc - asset_sam_region_000030; legend T tile - draft_legend_tile_t - asset_sam_region_000031; legend S tile - draft_legend_tile_s - asset_sam_region_000032; schedule r3c1 S tile - draft_exp2_tile_r3c1 - asset_sam_region_000033; schedule r2c1 S tile - draft_exp2_tile_r2c1 - asset_sam_region_000034; schedule r2c2 S tile - draft_exp2_tile_r2c2 - asset_sam_region_000035. Content not covered by SAM, including frames, arrows, text, panels, undetected tiles, and labels, is retained.
